sentences.text: 4 10-07-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present appeal has been filed by the appellant against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 28.10.2024 and 23.11.2024, passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge-VI-cum-Spl Judge, POCSO Act, Samastipur in POCSO Trial No. 232 of 2024, arising out of Samastipur Town P.S.Case No 276 of 2023, whereby the appellant was convicted under Sections 376(1) of the IPC, Section 4 of the POCSO Act and under Section 67(B) of I.T. Act and he was sentenced to undergo RI of 10 years and a fine of Rs. 20,000/- under Section 4 of the POCSO Act and in default of fine, was directed to undergo RI of six months.

sentences.text: to the prosecution case, the appellant called the victim to his house in connection with the treatment of his sister and at the pretext of drinking tea.
The appellant offered her tea laced with intoxicating substance, causing her to become unconscious.
Thereafter the appellant committed rape upon the victim and took her naked photographs.
The appellant then started blackmailing the victim and committed rape upon her multiple times and threatened to make the obscene photographs viral.
On 12.10.2023, the appellant sent those photographs from his mobile to the mobile of victim's mother and brother.

4. The learned counsel for the appellant, while making prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail, has submitted that the appellant has been awarded maximum sentence of 10 years RI,
whereas he has remained in custody for two years.
The prosecution has not examined any independent witness.

There is no eye-witness to the occurrence Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ)
No.5599 of 2024(4) dt.10-07-2025 and there is no likelihood of the appeal being taken up for hearing in near future.
5. Considering the above facts and circumstances, presently I am not inclined to suspend the sentence of the appellant and grant him the privilege of bail, which is hereby rejected.
6. Let this appeal be listed for final hearing on 25.08.2025 at the top of the list.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) HR/-
